bias.zh: 回调 · 测试 100 日均线，仍低于 $195

read.en: Zscaler fell 0.3% on Nov 12 to $193.22, trading $184.63–194.40. It is below the 5-day ($195.7), 10-day ($209.4) and 30-day ($221.6), all falling, and above the rising 100-day ($184.1) and the 200-day ($166.6). MACD has been below its signal since Nov 2, below zero, histogram flat; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 2 ($235.27), and RSI is 36.0.
read.zh: Zscaler 11月12日下跌 0.3%，收于 $193.22，盘中区间 $184.63–194.40。股价位于 5 日（$195.7）、10 日（$209.4）和 30 日均线（$221.6）下方，三者均在下行；位于上行的 100 日均线（$184.1）和 200 日均线（$166.6）上方。MACD 自 11月2日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图持平；抛物线 SAR 自 11月2日起看空（$235.27），RSI 为 36.0。

read.en: The $184.63 low cut through the $187.5–188.9 September lows and tested the 100-day, but the close recovered above both; the $194.40 high stayed under $195. Resistance is $194.4–195.8 (Sep 29 and Oct 2 lows, 5-day), then $201.6–203 and $209.4–210.5 (10-day, Nov 6 high). Support is $187.5–188.9, then $184.1–184.6 (100-day, Nov 12 low) and $166.6 (200-day). A close above $195.8 would target $202–203; below $184.1, $166.6.
